owner-selects во вкладке Стратегии; не включается автоматически
notes: The owner-provided Discord-only Windows preset carries --wf-tcp-out=80,443,1080,2053,2083,2087,2096,5222,8443, but its hostfakesplit blocks did not repeat 5222. This Linux seed deliberately includes 5222 in the owner-confirmed nft/NFQUEUE scope to test that hint.
This strategy is not expected by itself to fix a Discord updater socket that remains in SYN-SENT on TCP/443; it is a clean Discord-only comparison seed.
Windows --wf-* and WinDivert raw parts are not executed on Linux. The Linux runtime still uses owner-confirmed nftables output queueing.
The voice/STUN part of the Windows preset is intentionally not included here; Stage 8 remains reserved for voice/UDP.
